campaign: AI changes the story. Know what it means for you.

turns: The meeting starts in five minutes. Someone asks what AI changes for your team. What do you say?
Something about transformation. Then look thoughtfully at a window.

would_you_trust_ai.hook: Would you let AI send it?
turns: Would you let AI write an email to your boss?
Draft it? Absolutely. Send it without me reading it? Absolutely not.
A small but rather career-preserving distinction.
The exciting part and the awkward questions. We make room for both on The AI Edge.
